def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import deque
    q=deque((r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==7)
    seen=set(q)
    while q:
        r,c=q.popleft()
        for rr,cc in ((r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)):
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and (rr,cc) not in seen and grid[rr][cc]==0:
                seen.add((rr,cc)); out[rr][cc]=7; q.append((rr,cc))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    """Copy the marker's shape into every zero-only placement in the grid."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 7]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = {(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in pts}
    for a in range(h):
        for b in range(w):
            loc = [(a + dr, b + dc) for dr, dc in shape]
            if not all(0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w for r, c in loc):
                continue
            if any(grid[r][c] == 7 for r, c in loc):
                continue
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in loc):
                for r, c in loc:
                    out[r][c] = 7
    return out
